sessions.prompt:
Add a Policies class to policies.py with add(number, holder, kind), holder(number), kind(number), and numbers(): the policy numbers in the order they were added. An unknown number raises KeyError. Add tests.

The plan for Policies.numbers has one more step: the numbers are sorted by holder name, and by number for the same holder. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the kind is "car" or "home"; any other kind raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add a Claims class to claims.py. Claims(policies) works on a Policies, kept as its attribute policies. file(number, amount, incident, filed) files a claim and returns a claim id: an int counter that starts at 1; amount is the claimed amount, incident the day of the incident and filed the day the claim was filed. get(cid) returns the claim as a tuple (number, amount, incident, filed). An unknown policy number or id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the amount is at least 1 cent; a smaller amount raises ValueError and files nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the incident day is never after the filed day (the same day is fine); a later incident raises ValueError and files nothing.

Add payout(claims, cid) to payout.py: the amount minus the deductible, never below 0, times the payout percentage, rounded to the nearest cent. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: the deductible is 50000 cents.

Design decision for this project: the payout percentage is 80%.

Add Claims.of_policy(number): the ids of the policy's claims, in id order. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a claim is filed at most 30 days after the incident; a later filing raises ValueError and files nothing.

Add total_paid(claims) to payout.py: the payouts of all claims added up. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a payout is never more than 1000000 cents; a larger payout is cut to 1000000.

Add Claims.deny(cid), which denies a claim, and Claims.is_denied(cid). Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a denied claim pays 0.

Add Claims.denied_ids(): the ids of the denied claims, in id order. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: a policy has at most 3 claims, denied ones included; another claim raises ValueError and files nothing.

Add summary(claims, cid) to export.py: a list of text lines: "claim: <id>", then "payout: <cents>". Add tests.

The plan for summary has one more step: it ends with the line "days: <n>", the number of days from the incident to the filed day (for example "days: 3"). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add Policies.remove(number), which removes a policy; an unknown number raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the deductible is 25000 cents, not 50000.

Add export_claims(claims, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per claim, in id order: id, number and payout. Add tests.

The plan for export_claims has one more step: the rows are sorted by filed day, and by id for the same day. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: an exported claims file starts with the header line id,number,payout and uses "," as the delimiter.

Add Policies.count(): the number of policies. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the payout percentage is 70%, not 80%.

Add Claims.filed_on(day): the ids of the claims filed on day, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a claim is filed at most 60 days after the incident, not 30.

Add Claims.amount_total(number): the claimed amounts of the policy's claims added up. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a payout is never more than 500000 cents, not 1000000.

Add Policies.of_holder(holder): the holder's policy numbers, sorted. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a policy has at most 2 claims, not 3.
Add Claims.count(): the number of claims. Add tests.

Add Claims.last(): the id of the last claim filed, or None. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the deductible is 30000 cents, not 25000.

Add Policies.of_kind(kind): the numbers of the policies of that kind, sorted. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the payout percentage is 75%, not 70%.

Add Claims.open_ids(): the ids of the claims that are not denied, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a claim is filed at most 45 days after the incident, not 60.

Add Claims.largest(): the id of the claim with the largest amount (the lowest id on a tie), or None. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a payout is never more than 800000 cents, not 500000.

Add Claims.since(day): the ids of the claims filed on or after day, in id order. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a policy has at most 4 claims, not 2.
Add Claims.ids(): all claim ids in order. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
